# nns

## preamble

```{r load-deps, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(RANN)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidytext)
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.explore)
source("code/_utils.R")
```

## loading

```{r load-data}
sce <- readRDS("outs/fil.rds")
ist <- readRDS("outs/lv1.rds")
jst <- readRDS("outs/lv2.rds")
```

## wrangling

```{r prep-data}
idx <- names(kid <- ist$clust)
kid[kid == "epi"] <- "str"
sce$lv1 <- kid[match(colnames(sce), idx)]
kid <- lapply(jst, \(.) .$clust)
idx <- names(kid <- unlist(unname(kid)))
sce$lv2 <- kid[match(colnames(sce), idx)]
```

## context

### radial

```{r nns}
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
names(id) <- id <- names(cs)
r <- 0.02; k <- 101
# get radial neighborhood
is <- lapply(id, \(sid) {
    sub <- sce[, cs[[sid]]]
    xy <- "Center(X|Y)_global_mm"
    xy <- grep(xy, names(colData(sub)))
    xy <- as.matrix(colData(sub)[xy])
    nn <- nn2(xy, searchtype="radius", r=r, k=k)
    is <- nn$nn.idx[, -1]; is[is == 0] <- NA; is
})
```

### range

```{r plt-ns, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5}
#| code-fold: true
#| echo: -1
par(mar=c(4,4,2,2))
n <- unlist(lapply(is, \(.) rowSums(!is.na(.))))
l <- sprintf("#cells in %sum radial neighborhood", r*1e3)
hist(n, breaks=seq(-.5, max(n)+.5), xlab="", ylab="",  main=l)
abline(v=quantile(n, c(.05, .95)), col="red", lw=2, lty=2)
abline(v=m <- mean(n), col="red", lw=2); m
```

### quant

```{r fqs}
# quantify each neighborhood's
# subpopulation composition
fq <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    ks <- (se <- sce[, cs[[.]]])$lv2
    ks[is.na(ks)] <- "tum"
    mx <- matrix(ks[is[[.]]], nrow=ncol(se))
    mx[is.na(mx)] <- ""
    names(kt) <- kt <- levels(sce$lv2)
    ns <- sapply(kt, \(k) rowSums(mx == k))
    data.frame(
        prop.table(ns, 1),
        row.names=colnames(se))
}) |> bind_rows()
fq[is.na(fq)] <- 0
fq <- fq[colnames(sce), ]
colData(sce)$fqs <- fq
```

### clust

```{r clu}
set.seed(260202)
km <- kmeans(fq, centers=nk <- 10)$cluster
names(km) <- rownames(fq)
ns <- sprintf("%02d", seq_len(nk))
ns <- factor(km, labels=paste0("N", ns))
sce$ctx <- ns[match(colnames(sce), names(ns))]
t(sapply(cs, \(.) table(ns[.]))); table(ns)
```

## density

### est

```{r den-tum-viz, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# get point pattern using per-core 
# convex hull as window of observation
xy <- grep("global_mm", names(cd <- colData(sce)))
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pp <- lapply(cs, \(.) {
    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))
    xy <- xy[which(cd$lv1[.] == "tum"), ]
    pp <- ppp(xy[,1], xy[,2], window=ow)
})
# visualize kernel density estimate
# of tumoral density across cores
kd <- lapply(pp, density.ppp)
par(mfrow=c(4, 5), mar=c(1,0,0,0))
for (. in names(kd)) plot(kd[[.]], main=., col=pals::jet())
```

### bin

```{r den-tum-bin, warning=FALSE, results="hold", fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# estimate tumoral density at
# observed cellular coordinates
fn <- lapply(pp, densityfun)
ds <- lapply(names(fn), \(.) {
    xy <- cd[cs[[.]], xy]
    fn[[.]](xy[,1], xy[,2], drop=FALSE)
})
is <- match(colnames(sce), unlist(cs))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), kde=unlist(ds)[is])
xs <- seq(min(ds <- .q(df$kde)), max(ds), l=26)
df$bin <- cut(ds, breaks=xs, include.lowest=TRUE)
sce$kde <- df$kde; sce$bin <- df$bin
hist(ds, n=100, 
    xlab="q-scaled tumoral density", 
    ylab="# cells", main="")
abline(v=xs, col="red")
```

## visuals

### spatial

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r plt-xy, results="asis", fig.dpi=100, fig.width=10, fig.height=3}
idx <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pol <- read_parquet("outs/pol.parquet", as_data_frame=FALSE)
pal <- list(lv1=.pal_sub, lv2=.pal_kid, ctx=.pal_ctx)
pal <- lapply(pal, \(.) scale_fill_manual(drop=FALSE, values=.))
for (. in names(pal)) sce[[.]] <- factor(sce[[.]])
for (. in names(idx)) {
    se <- sce[, idx[[.]]]
    ps <- lapply(names(pal), \(j) {
        id <- if (j == names(pal)[2]) .
        .plt_ps(pol, se, j, id=id, lw=0.1, lc="white") + pal[[j]]
    })
    gg <- wrap_plots(ps, nrow=1) & theme(plot.margin=margin(r=5))
    cat("####", ., "\n"); print(gg); cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

### comps

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r plt-fq, results="asis", message=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
ys <- list(sid=.pal_sid, lv1=.pal_sub, lv2=.pal_kid)
ps <- lapply(setNames(names(ys), names(ys)), \(.) {
    ps <- list(
        .plt_fq(sce, "ctx", .) + scale_fill_manual(values=ys[[.]]),
        .plt_fq(sce, ., "ctx") + scale_fill_manual(values=.pal_ctx))
    wrap_plots(ps) & coord_equal(20, expand=FALSE)
})
for (. in names(ps)) {cat("####", ., "\n"); print(ps[[.]]); cat("\n\n")}
```

### density

```{r plt-den-fq, fig.align="center", fig.width=12, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
names(by) <- by <- c("sid", "lv2")
pal <- list(sid=.pal_sid, lv2=.pal_kid)
ps <- lapply(by, \(by) {
    fd <- df |>
        add_count(!!!sym(by)) |>
        group_by(bin, !!!sym(by)) |>
        summarise_at("n", sum) |>
        group_by(!!!sym(by)) |>
        mutate(p=n/sum(n))
    names(fd)[2] <- "y"
    if (by == "lv2") fd <- filter(fd, y != "tum")
    ggplot(fd, aes(bin, n, fill=y)) +
        coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE) +
        scale_fill_manual(by, values=pal[[by]]) +
        labs(x="tumoral density", y="frequency") +
        geom_col(position="fill", key_glyph="point") +
        .thm_fig_d("minimal", "f") + theme(
            aspect.ratio=2/3,
            axis.text=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks=element_blank())
}); wrap_plots(ps, nrow=1)
```

```{r den-lv2-lm, fig.align="center", fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
fit <- by(
    fd <- ps$lv2@data, paste(fd$y), 
    \(.) lm(p~as.integer(bin), data=.))
b <- sapply(fit, \(.) as.numeric(coef(.)[2]))
. <- abs(b) > (th <- 0.005); b[.] <- th*sign(b[.])
gg <- data.frame(k=names(b), b=100*b)
gg <- filter(gg, abs(b) > 0.01)
ggplot(gg, aes(b, reorder(k, b), fill=b)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
        limits=100*c(-th, th),
        colors=rev(pals::brewer.rdbu(9))) +
    labs(x="de/increase with density (capped)", y=NULL) +
    .thm_fig_d("bw", "f") + theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
    geom_col(width=0.8, show.legend=FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=100*c(-th, th))
```

```{r den-lv2-hm, fig.align="center", fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
# wrangling
mu <- df |>
    pivot_longer(starts_with("fqs")) |>
    group_by(name, bin) |>
    summarize_at("value", mean) |>
    group_by(name) |>
    mutate_at("value", .z)
# ordering
yo <- mu |>
    group_by(name) |>
    slice_max(value, n=1, with_ties=FALSE) |>
    arrange(bin, value) |>
    pull(name)
# plotting
ggplot(mu, 
    aes(bin, name, fill=value)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
        "z-scaled frequency in 20um radial\nneighborhood of tumor cells",
        colors=rev(pals::brewer.puor(9)), 
        limits=c(-2.5, 2.5), breaks=seq(-2, 2, 2)) +
    scale_y_discrete(NULL, limits=yo, labels=\(.) gsub("fqs\\.", "", .)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE) +
    labs(x="tumoral density") +
    geom_tile() +
    .thm_fig_c("minimal") + theme(
        aspect.ratio=1,
        legend.position="top",
        legend.title.position="top",
        legend.title=element_text(hjust=0.5),
        legend.key.height=unit(0.4, "lines"),
        legend.key.width=unit(0.8, "lines"),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
```

### coloc

```{r plt-col, fig.width=5, fig.height=5.5}
#| code-fold: true
cd <- colData(sce)[c("lv2")]
df <- data.frame(cd, fq)
mu <- df |>
    group_by(lv2) |>
    summarise(
        across(where(is.numeric),
        \(.) mean(., na.rm=TRUE)))
# scaling
mv <- mu |>
    pivot_longer(-lv2) |>
    group_by(name) |> 
    mutate_at("value", .z)
# wrangling
mx <- pivot_wider(mv)
my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
rownames(my) <- mx[[1]]
# plotting
lab <- "z-scaled frequency of X in radial neighborhood of Y"
pal <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("navy", "ivory", "maroon"))
set.seed(3); hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(my, pal, name=lab,
    row_title=NULL, 
    column_title=NULL,
    width=unit(10, "cm"), 
    height=unit(10, "cm"),
    km=10, column_km=10,
    row_dend_width=unit(0.5, "cm"),
    column_dend_height=unit(0.5, "cm"),
    heatmap_legend_param=list(
        direction="horizontal",
        grid_height=unit(2, "mm"),
        legend_width=unit(4, "cm"),
        at=. <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, 0.5),
        title_position="topcenter",
        labels=ifelse(. %% 2 == 0, ., "")))
ComplexHeatmap::draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side="top")
```

```{r plt-nns, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
cd <- colData(sce)[c("lv2")]
df <- data.frame(fq, cd)
fd <- pivot_longer(df, -names(cd))
mu <- fd |>
    group_by(lv2, name) |>
    mutate_at("name", factor) |>
    summarize_at("value", mean)
mv <- filter(mu, name != "tum")
xo <- mu |>
    filter(name == "tum") |>
    arrange(value) |> 
    pull(lv2)
ggplot(mu, aes(lv2, value, fill=name)) + 
    ggtitle("cells in radial neighborhood of x") +
ggplot(mv, aes(lv2, value, fill=name)) + 
    ggtitle("excluding tumor fraction") +
plot_layout(guides="collect") &
    geom_col(position="fill", key_glyph="point", show.legend=TRUE) &
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, drop=FALSE, values=.pal_kid) &
    scale_x_discrete(limits=xo) &
    .thm_fig_d("minimal", "f") & 
    coord_equal(expand=FALSE) &
    theme(aspect.ratio=2/3,
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5))
```

## labeling

```{r lab}
lab <- list(
    TUM=c("N10", "N07"),
    RIM=c("N01", "N08"),
    MYE="N09",
    MIX=c("N04", "N06"),
    CAF="N02",
    TCZ="N03",
    EPI="N05"
)
lap <- setNames(rep.int(names(lab), sapply(lab, length)), unlist(lab))
sce$cty <- factor(lap[match(sce$ctx, names(lap))], names(lab))
table(sce$cty, sce$ctx, useNA="ifany")
```
